recipes.name: Cheesecake
instructions: Crush the biscuits (crumbled, but not dust).
Melt the butter, then pour over the biscuits. Mix well.
Pour into a 20cm circular tin, pressing down to form an even base. Chill for 30 minutes.
Mix cream cheese, icing sugar and vanilla extract slowly for 30 seconds to combine.
Add the double cream, then mix for 2 minutes until firmer.
Spread mixture over the base and allow to chill overnight.
